description: Cost Model for Pumped Storage Hydropower Geomembrane Lining Systems is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Scott DeNeale, Antonia Chu (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). The Cost Model for Pumped Storage Hydropower Geomembrane Lining Systems offers an approximation of geomembrane lining system costs for pumped storage hydropower (PSH) reservoirs. Geomembrane lining systems have been used around the world for over 60 years for the construction of dams and reservoirs. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026.
